The '''WQ80 barrel''', also known as the '''"Longshot" barrel''', was a model of [[marksman barrel]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] for [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. The barrels cost 1200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The barrels were designed to increase a rifle's range<ref name="EOTEC" /> and accuracy, and measured two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="AORC" />

==Behind the scenes==
WQ80 barrel were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
